mechanics.claim: Bravado triggers after casting any ability, empowering the next two basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Taric''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}}

mechanics.claim: The first empowered attack refreshes the 5-second duration.
Casting another ability while one empowered attack remains refreshes duration and grants another empowered attack, but no more than two stored at once.
mechanics.quote: Subsequent ability casts will refresh the duration and grant another empowered attack if '''Taric''' has one attack remaining.

mechanics.claim: Bravado may only grant up to two empowered attacks at a time.
mechanics.quote: ''Bravado'' may only grant up to two empowered attacks.

mechanics.claim: The bonus magic damage does not apply to structures.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage will not apply against {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: The damage is dealt on-attack (an on-hit effect tied to the basic attack landing).
Bravado cannot miss due to blind, but cooldown reduction does not apply if the attack is dodged or blocked.
mechanics.quote: it cannot ''miss'' if '''Taric''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}. The cooldown reduction still applies when {{tip|blind|blinded}}, however it does not apply on {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blocked}} ''Bravado'' attacks.
